options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

options.name: triggers
options.description: Trigger characters with their async providers: { char, provider(query, { signal, trigger }), label?, minChars? }.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial value: plain text or { text, mentions }; also restored by reset().

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; the hidden input carries the JSON value.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty text is invalid; shows the required indicator.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the field.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted, not editable; no suggestions.

options.name: multiline
options.description: true: a textarea; false: a single-line input with the combobox role.

options.name: rows
options.description: Visible rows of the textarea.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: Maximum length in code points (validated, not truncated).

options.name: showCounter
options.description: Show remaining/over characters; requires maxLength.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: debounce
options.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and the provider call (0 to 5000).

options.name: maxSuggestions
options.description: Most suggestions shown at once (1 to 50).

options.name: locale
options.description: Message and number-formatting locale.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: value
properties.description: { text, mentions }, mentions sorted by start.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Whether the suggestion list is open.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no events); a string clears the mentions; mismatched mentions throw.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (multiline is fixed at creation).

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, pending queries, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: The text or mentions changed: { value, validity }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Committed: a mention was inserted, or focus left with a changed value.

cssClasses.name: aui-mention-input__option | __option--active
cssClasses.description: A suggestion and the active suggestion.

cssClasses.name: aui-mention-input__status
cssClasses.description: Loading, no matches, or failure text.
